notes: Exact component set validated on Apple-silicon macOS in Phases 1-4A: GHDL 6.0.0 from the official GHDL release, macOS 15 aarch64 build with the LLVM JIT backend (Apio's own GHDL does not launch on macOS 27: duplicate LC_RPATH; the ahead-of-time LLVM build validated in Phases 1-4A links every elaborated design with the system cc/ld, i.e. it needs Xcode Command Line Tools, which a student Mac does not have and which cannot be redistributed; the LLVM JIT build of the same release elaborates in memory and was verified in Phase 4B to give identical simulation output, GHW, VCD (apart from its $date line) and synthesized Verilog), the Apio 1.7.0 darwin-arm64 bundle of release 2026-09-27 (identical to the validated /Applications/Apio install), and the Apio package set Apio 1.7.0 installs on darwin-arm64 (definitions, oss-cad-suite, verible, openxc7; Apio restricts drivers and graphviz to windows-amd64), with openXC7 pinned to 2026-09-25 (parts-index schema 7; 2026-09-27 moved to schema 8) and its xc7a100t chipdb. Staged from the official release archives below; nothing is upgraded for uniformity with Windows.

environment.notes: Every bundled tool runs with PATH = the operating-system folders only (/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin; Apio adds its own package folders), inherited APIO_* and PYTHON* variables removed, and Python bytecode writing disabled so the immutable bundle is never written to. No Python shim is needed on macOS: openXC7's fasm2frames/bit2fasm wrappers run the package's own libexec/python3.12 with PYTHONHOME set to the package, and Apio is a self-contained PyInstaller executable with its own Python 3.14.

components.license: GPL-2.0-or-later; libgnat GPL-3.0 with GCC Runtime Library Exception; libgcc_s GCC Runtime Library Exception; LLVM (statically linked into bin/ghdl) Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception
components.licenseEvidence: Upstream COPYING.md (https://github.com/ghdl/ghdl/blob/v6.0.0/COPYING.md); the binary archive contains no license file of its own. bin/ghdl statically links LLVM 22.1.0 (Homebrew LLVM build, string 'Homebrew LLVM version 22.1.0') and the GNAT 14.2.0 runtime; lib/ also ships libgnat-14.dylib and libgcc_s.1.1.dylib (GCC 14.2.0 runtime). IEEE library sources under lib/ghdl/src/ieee2008 carry their own LICENSE.
